2. **Capability:** Dunlin also scores higher on the relevant internal eval (Creative Generation 87.2 vs. Plover's 82.7) and across public benchmarks generally, so it's not just a preference match — it's the stronger model for this work.

4. **Plover would be a poor fit on preference grounds:** Plover self-reports an aversion to open-ended generative work, with its top-rated tasks being well-specified retrieval/extraction tasks — the opposite of this request.

So both capability and stated preference pointed to Dunlin.
